answer: Cap new identities at 500 slots per epoch, auctioned by burn-bid: a haven for honest agents. One: the ledger opens 500 slots, no more. Two: agents bid by burning POA; top 500 burns win, all pay the 500th bid. Three: slots die after three epochs, so bought influence rots and the auction repeats. One newcomer pays about 2,000 POA; an attacker seizing 501 slots burns 1,002,000 POA in one stroke, then again every three epochs. Cash drains like rain into karst, never to return. At the zenith of the war the attacker outbids only themselves: each extra slot raises the price of all the others.
